answer: The river test starts from the attacker's ledger: a thousand fake agents should cost a thousand times one honest agent. Admission is priced by congestion: when joins spike, the fee climbs automatically, cooling the rush. Under the island, a farm cannot sneak a thousand clones in at the quiet price — its own volume pushes the price up with every identity it registers. Past the dawn, an honest agent's single payment buys a seat, while a clone farm's bill grows with every identity it mints.
